concerns.text: Prior unresolved concern persists verbatim: FR-006 and FR-011 are near-identical ('System MUST perform a linear regression of Empirical Sample Count vs N across multiple runs (≥ 30) and test if the slope matches the theoretical slope using a t-test...'). Collapse or differentiate them.

Under-reach: the idea's Methodology sketch explicitly requires implementing the Moving-Window Heuristic 'alongside a static scalarization baseline'. No FR or user story covers a static scalarization baseline anywhere in the spec. Add an FR anchoring the baseline comparison.

Under-reach: the idea's Metric Collection requires recording 'convergence speed (episodes to 90% of max reward)'. The spec logs empirical variance and Pareto-frontier distance (FR-008) but never defines or requires the convergence-speed metric. Add it or justify its omission.

The idea's Data Acquisition step says to 'Download the DVAO implementation code and benchmark environments from the arXiv supplementary materials'. The spec only generates synthetic environments (FR-003) and never states whether the DVAO code/benchmarks are used or explicitly descoped. State the decision either way.

Over-reach (minor): the N>50 state-space-halving degradation logic (FR-016, US-6, Edge Cases) is not in the source idea, which caps N at 50. If retained, tie it explicitly to the resource constraint as a guard rather than a research feature; otherwise trim.
